GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly, slow into stride (-1 length), Settled Down last 11 Lengths from the lead, hooked 3 Wide at 1050m, circled field to trail 1 length 3 Wide turning, Dropped Out in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly with its head up in the early stages.] # slow/wide/worked
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and lost ground. Raced keen early, with its head up. Raced three wide without cover in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well & Settled Down 1 length on fence, Drifted Back to 2.5 Lengths turning, Lost Ground in Straight # no excuses
Jumped Ok Restrained Straight Out The Back from Outside Settled Down rear 10 Lengths Good Pace on, went 5 Wide Turning for home Kept Coming hit the Lead in the shadows, # pace on, too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Fractious leaving the mounting yard. Began awkwardly. Warning for its pre-race manners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.25 Lengths 3 Wide , worked up and took Lead crossing at 1400m, Held Together in front until being Headed 600m, Drifted Back to 2 Lengths rail turning, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # work a bit early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keen early and when being restrained passing the 1400m, got its head up on a number of occasions.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok comf Went Forward 3 Wide out of Straight Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear Soon After with 1st following race run to suit , Ridden Along Turning for home Collared x 250m, Couldn'T Go On - # had all favours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Fractious entering the course proper. On the way to the gates, Rdr lost the use of both irons and the horse galloped until it pulled up near the 700m. Underwent a pre-race vet exam.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing a long neck, held together much same to turn Two Wide trailing 0.75 Lengths , hit Lead 275m, Headed 200m, reclaimed Lead 50m from post # battled on well
Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn 2 Lengths Two Wide , Lost Ground in Straight # no excuses
Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward Took sit 1x1 3rd following 1st x 2 Lengths Ridden Along x 600m, Couldn'T Go On @ 400m, had its chance - # had all favours

Jumped awkwardly then Went Forward to 2 Lengths joint Lead on fence, Headed 1500m then held together much same to turn 2 Lengths rail, shifted out 3 Wide Straightening Up and ran on hitting Lead 50m from post # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and then bumped and became unbalanced.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn then shifted out to 1 length 3 Wide , hit Lead 120m and kept going to post # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Laid in approaching the 400m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Hampoered on jumping & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Eased and in Two Wide at 800m, Drifted Back to 4 Lengths rail turning, hugged fence turning, Held Up from 400m to straightening then Made Some Ground along rail in Straight # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hampered on jumping. Laid in passing the 400m before being awkwardly placed on heels and held up for some distance.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , led but held Two Wide 1000m, Headed at 600m and took sit behind Tearaway Leader , Ridden Along before the corner and weakened in Straight # beaten turn
